$comment: The Gradle distributions bin/jvm-resolve.sh will let a repo download, and the sha256 each one must hash to. This is the LISTED RELEASES half of the egress decision: github.com is reachable from the resolution container because services.gradle.org 307-redirects distribution downloads to github.com/gradle/gradle-distributions/releases, and there is no way to allow that at path granularity — squid sees only CONNECT host:443 for HTTPS, and seeing the path would mean TLS interception. So the host is allowed and the BYTES are pinned. The pin is what makes the allowance safe; without it the entry would be trust.
howItIsEnforced: bin/jvm-resolve.sh injects `distributionSha256Sum` into the gradle-wrapper.properties of the SCRATCH COPY — never the repository. The Gradle wrapper then verifies the downloaded zip itself and refuses to run on a mismatch. Enforcement is by the wrapper, not by a reviewer reading a list, which is the difference between a control and a note.
unlistedIsRefused: A repo whose wrapper asks for a distribution not listed here does not run. That is deliberate and it is the point: an unlisted version means nobody has recorded what bytes to expect, and downloading it anyway would be exactly the trust this file exists to remove. Adding a version is a human act — fetch its published sum, record it, say who checked.
provenanceOfTheseHashes: Fetched 2026-08-27 from https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-<v>.zip.sha256 over TLS. That is Gradle's own published checksum, served from the canonical origin — a reasonable anchor and NOT an independent verification. `confirmedBy` is null on every entry below because nobody has cross-checked them against a second source. That field is the honest record of how much this list is worth, and it should be filled in rather than assumed.
derivedFrom: The eight entries are exactly what this fleet's 11 gradle-wrapper.properties files declare as of 2026-08-27, enumerated rather than guessed. Two of those repos (junit-team_junit-framework, apache_calcite) already pin their own distribution and need nothing from this file.
